sources.released_version_or_commit: Apache CouchDB 3.5 stable docs; stable URL not commit-pinned
sources.observed_operation: Opened official docs at named sections
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Conflicts are leaf revisions; ordinary GET hides conflict existence and returns deterministic winner; conflicts=true lists other leaves; compaction discards non-leaf bodies; revision pruning bounds history
sources.applicability: Couch/Pouch alternative; requires explicit enumeration and separate archival retention

critic_stage_observation_record.observed_operation: Opened official documentation directly and read conflict and history sections.
critic_stage_observation_record.governing_condition_default_exception: Offline conflicting revisions coexist; ordinary GET returns deterministic winner only; conflict leaves require explicit retrieval; compaction discards non-leaf bodies and pruning bounds history.
critic_stage_observation_record.applicability: Supports Pouch/Couch alternative limitations and the need for explicit review/retention; not app-specific.

reviser_rechecks.title: CouchDB replication/conflict model
reviser_rechecks.locator: §2.3.1–2.3.4; concurrent branches/winner lines 23–56; revision-tree, compaction/pruning lines 82–101; conflict retrieval 102–135
reviser_rechecks.observed_operation: Reopened official docs; read cited conflict and history sections.
reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: Offline peers retain both concurrent revisions; ordinary GET hides nonwinning leaves behind a deterministic winner; compaction drops non-leaf bodies and pruning bounds history.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: Supports explicit conflict retrieval and separate retention; not app-specific.

reviser_rechecks.title: PouchDB replication guide
reviser_rechecks.locator: Live replication/retry lines 69–97; local peer examples
reviser_rechecks.observed_operation: Reopened official guide; checked disconnect/retry behavior.
reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: Live replication stops after an offline error unless retry is enabled; configured retry resumes on reconnection.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: Supports reconnect/local-peer comparison, not manual-file UX or app compatibility.

reviser_rechecks.title: PouchDB conflicts guide
reviser_rechecks.observed_operation: Reopened official guide; read concurrent offline example and conflict APIs.
reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: Concurrent offline branches can coexist; a deterministic revision wins but the conflict API exposes other revision IDs for application handling.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: Supports explicit review; not an application merge policy.

reviser_rechecks.title: PouchDB attachment guide
reviser_rechecks.observed_operation: Reopened official guide; compared normal and full reads.
reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: Normal reads return stub/digest; attachments:true returns binary payload as base64; these are database-managed attachments.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: Supports distinguishing references from payload transfer.

reviser_rechecks.title: PouchDB issue #8456
reviser_rechecks.observed_operation: Reopened first-party issue; checked the branch/attachment case and PR linkage.
reviser_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: A particular IndexedDB replication case could associate a digest with a revision that did not carry the attachment; competing revisions and compaction exposed the stale reference.
reviser_rechecks.applicability: Bounded failure scenario, not a claim about every adapter.

reviser_rechecks.title: SQLite atomic commit/crash tests
reviser_rechecks.locator: §8 crash tests lines 405–410 and §9 platform/flush caveats 411–438
